correctness.rationale: Reconstructed RESULT.md lines 44–102. With X=x-u+1 the three branch images partition [0,1+δ); the first return to [0,1) is addition of λ modulo 1, with one extra step precisely on [1−λ,1−λ+δ). For λ=p/q the q base visits form a grid of spacing 1/q; its phase meets the delay interval n or n+1 times on respective fractions 1−θ and θ, where qδ=n+θ (exactly n when θ=0). The q return steps are necessary before any physical return, and the corresponding tower class has length (q+m)/q times its base length. Integrating the linear phase fractions against |dy|=d(qδ)/(qc) gives half weights at the two endpoints, unit weights inside, and normalization pq+p²/2. At δ=λ the grid has p delayed visits; at and above y* the interval [-v−(1−λ),-v+λ) carries the width-one rotation. In the irrational case each orbit visits the base and is dense there and in the extra level; every invariant probability restricts to a positive base mass inducing a rotation-invariant probability, and its extra-level mass is forced by the base restriction. Thus normalized length is the only invariant probability. Changes on branch rays affect at most countably many translated null sets under iteration. The supplied exact-rational script was inspected, not executed; its recorded finite checks do not justify the universal claims, which were established analytically.
